scope: Native S+5 ordered two-row String result: Data1 is exactly S and completes row1; Data2 is an exact 5-byte new row, not a continuation. Context-held census and full normal MySQL literal oracle; excludes malformed reply/prefix-only refusal and physical last-alias exit.
sql: SELECT payload FROM (SELECT 0 AS ordinal, REPEAT('x', 1048568) AS payload UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS ordinal, '' AS payload) ordered_rows ORDER BY ordinal ASC
